title: Jensen Huang to face DC grilling the same day Nvidia releases new products at GTC
summary: Jensen Huang, the CEO of Nvidia, is set to face scrutiny in Washington on the same day the company unveils its latest products at the GTC event. This dual challenge highlights the pressures on Huang as he navigates both corporate leadership and political accountability. The outcome of his congressional appearance could significantly impact Nvidia's reputation and future endeavors in the tech industry.
